thread:
priya: Proposal: consolidate cloud ref-archs into a single 'refkit-starter' repo with provider adapters and consistent Terraform module patterns. Reduce duplication and speed partner onboarding. Thoughts?

devon: +1. We need a common module spec and CI matrix across aws/azure/gcp.

kevin: Agree. Also must handle marketplace packaging differences per cloud. I can prototype a GH Actions adapter to emit provider artifacts.

elaine: Partnerships wants one-click examples and a secure default network layout. Add GPU SKU guidance and cost notes.

priya: Plan: repo layout, common variables/outputs, smoke tests, publish pipeline, ONBOARDING.md checklist for partners.

devon: Proposed minimal inputs: name, region, instance_type, node_count, subnet_id, tags. Outputs: lb_dns, instance_ids, module_version. Keep sensible defaults.

kevin: Packaging notes: AWS needs AMI/CFN or SaaS listing metadata; Azure wants image + listing; GCP needs marketplace metadata. Small adapter per provider makes sense.

elaine: ONBOARDING.md should include security review, sample deploy, billing SKU guidance, support contacts, and marketing blurb.

priya: Example README snippet to include:

```
module "refkit_inference" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/refkit-starter//modules/aws/inference"
  name = "refkit-dev"
  region = "us-west-2"
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
  node_count = 2
}
```

elaine: Also include a CPU-only example and cost caveats for evals.

devon: CI matrix: terraform fmt/check, tflint, terratest smoke on tiny instances, metadata validation. Gate PRs for providers touched.

kevin: I'll draft ci/matrix.yml and ci/publish.yml plus a metadata generator.

opsbot: CI job created: refkit-starter/ci/matrix queued.

priya: Timeline: devon -> RFC + skeleton by EOD Fri; kevin -> CI + packaging draft by Wed; elaine -> partner docs + onboarding by next Fri. Review RFC when PR up.

elaine: I'll prep onboarding checklist and partner email templates and tag GTM when ready. @here :thumbsup: 

devon: Opening RFC PR with skeleton (modules/aws, modules/azure, modules/gcp, examples, ci).

priya: Thanks all. We'll make a one-pager for execs after skeleton + CI demo.

opsbot: CI status: refkit-starter/ci/matrix queued -> running.
